subject.title: dotenv loader does not expand env references in .env files

question: Which dotenv sources, if any, may expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` references, and what should OpenClaw do when a referenced value is missing?
rationale: The code change is mechanically bounded, but the decision controls whether lower-trust workspace files can influence credentials/runtime controls and how provider auth aliases propagate into long-lived service environments.

options.title: Approve trusted-source expansion
options.body: Expand references only for trusted global/state-dir and legacy gateway dotenv sources after process-env precedence, keep workspace credential/control protections intact, and define missing refs as a fail-closed skip or error before implementation.

options.title: Keep no dotenv expansion
options.body: Document that `.env` values are literal and direct users to config `${VAR}` substitution, SecretRef, or shell import for aliasing.

options.title: Expand all dotenv sources
options.body: Allow project and global `.env` expansion with broad security tests, accepting a larger workspace-trust and upgrade review burden.

recommendation.title: Approve trusted-source expansion
recommendation.body: Expand references only for trusted global/state-dir and legacy gateway dotenv sources after process-env precedence, keep workspace credential/control protections intact, and define missing refs as a fail-closed skip or error before implementation.
